analysis:
Examined the complete supplied ProviderLoop.swift patch and BASE surrounding state/initialization (lines 1–1023) against the canonical definition index and selected T-041 detail. HEAD lines 781–792 add actor-isolated selected-model recovery state, an internal load override, and saved-versus-committed model-selection tracking; HEAD line 954 initializes the saved filter from startup configuration. These additions alone introduce no observed authorization bypass, plaintext exposure, billing change, external entry point, or weakened model/hash admission. Existing BASE initialization filters supported/eligible models (963–978), generates the process key (980), and establishes bounded slot/KV budgets (991–1006); those statements are unchanged by this patch.
Integration must examine ProviderLoop+SelectedModelRecovery and the new state's readers/writers: confirm recovery preserves no-eviction memory budgeting, shutdown/drain and add-on hold fences (A-018, T-059), failed-self-test retirement exclusions (BASE 417–430), and connection-bound serving permission (T-052/T-053). Confirm policy refresh only updates savedEnabledModels and committed switch updates enabledModelsAtLastSwitch without silently changing the serving set. Recovery-triggered reloads must retain weight/hash checks (T-012/T-027) and cache model/scope bindings (T-041). Those implementations and callers are outside this source batch; their absence is a coverage limit, not proof of a missing control. No independently supported regression qualifies in the supplied changes.
